name: Eira Llewellyn
bio:
Eira's journey into motorsport began not on the track, but in her grandfather's small engineering workshop in rural Wales. Surrounded by lathes and milling machines from a young age, she developed an innate understanding of metalwork and a passion for precision. After completing her apprenticeship and earning a degree in mechanical engineering, she sought a challenge that would combine her skills with her love for speed. EVO Racing Team offered just that, allowing her to apply her expertise to the intricate demands of high-performance racing machines.

Eira is known for her meticulous approach and her ability to diagnose and resolve complex mechanical issues efficiently. She thrives under pressure and has a knack for finding innovative solutions to improve performance. Beyond her technical abilities, Eira is a valuable asset to the team, mentoring junior machinists and fostering a collaborative environment. She believes in continuous learning and is always seeking new ways to push the boundaries of what's possible.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy hair, often tied back in a practical ponytail while working.
physical.description: Eira is of average height with a focused and observant gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical drawings and calculations.
Has a habit of humming traditional Welsh folk songs while working on complex tasks.
Insists on using a specific brand of cutting oil, claiming it improves the finish.
